abstract: Homeless dogs taken into animal shelters are difficult to match with suitable adopters, and shelter staff often keep adopter records as paper copies. The team built the Animal Adoption website, where adopters register, browse animals in a shelter, and send adoption requests that administrators approve or reject through automatic email notifications. A questionnaire built on eight dog breed characteristics recommends appropriate dogs to each adopter, and a follow up tracking function reminds administrators to check the status of adopted dogs twice a year. The system was written in C#, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with Visual Studio, stores data and pictures in SQL Server and FireStorage, sends email through SendGrid, and runs on Microsoft Azure.

abstract: SAMT Master is the administration section of an education platform developed for The Good Shepherd Company Limited, a company that connects teachers and students in sports, arts, music, and technology. The team extended the platform with a web based admin system covering five features. Administrators can review teacher applications with uploaded documents, create and manage job posts, track and assign error reports, and create searchable receipts for deposits, payment invoices, and withdrawals. A marketing heat map shows where potential customers are concentrated. It uses a scraping bot to collect leads from websites and the Google API to resolve each province and county into latitude and longitude for Google Maps pins. The design covers twenty database tables and the team plans to continue the project in senior project 2.

domain.evidence: SAMT master focuses on improving the Thai education system by connecting teachers who are looking for job and students who are looking for teachers, initially in the field of music.

abstract: This paper introduces the platform - AU Network Profiler - in which it explores user's behavior within the Assumption university's network and produce insights relating to those group of users. The platform combines the knowledge of network to preprocess incoming flow of packets into structural dataset, k-means clustering algorithm to produce user segmentation and later analyze those cohorts. The client-application includes the web interface which virtualized the cohort analysis and network utilization for the possible user to have the ability to understand the overview of their network. With its functionality to find user's behavior groups present in the network, AU Network Profiler has the ability to produce insights of the characteristic of each segment. Overall, to conclude about the AU Network Profiler, it is network analytic tools with a goal to understand the behavioristic of the user within the network.

canonical_title: Stampz: A Mobile Application for Collecting Stamps on Visited Tourist Destination
abstract: The number of people traveling without a tour guide has been increased recently, so the handy travel guide becomes an important tool for the traveler. Plus travelers nowadays are seeking for new place to visit and more exciting traveling. According to those problems, we had an idea and decided to create this project. Stampz is the iOS application which has three main features designed to greatly fit current traveler's trends and lifestyles. The first feature is discover, the application allows the user to discover places and their informations by browsing, searching, and exploring through stamp books in the system which will be provided by the admin using content-management web application. The second one is collect. The application allows the user to easily collect stamps from attractions in the list of each stamp book with their own mobile devices. The application relies on location-based services or GPS for deciding whether the user is close to the specified location. The last feature is share. The user will be able to share their interested stamp book and location through their own social media accounts. We have also evaluated our system by performing User Acceptance Test with Praram Nine Technology's representative which is the company who gave us the requirement and give back the feedback after experiencing our both mobile application and web application.

canonical_title: PeerShare: An Expense Sharing Mobile Application
abstract: Nowadays, convenience has become one of the necessities that govern a decision in expending money, especially in transactions done with many peers. Said transactions often are complicated and time-consuming as each peer would have to pass around a single receipt to calculate how much each of them owes the person who had paid on behalf of them. This scenario happened in almost every transaction we shared. PeerShare is an expense sharing mobile application proposes a more convenient solution for bill splitting. By taking a snapshot of the receipt then crop the part which contains item prices. Then, the owner of the bill (the person who paid first) sends a request asking money to each peer. Each peer can repay the amount owed back to the owner via AU Spark E-wallet. This step of the transaction happens within PeerShare application in which each peer has registered his or her E-wallet account.
